method: Production HTTP actions against an isolated migrated database, with a disclosed test-only timing intervention

timingIntervention.trigger: BEFORE INSERT on position_set; manual inserts slept 750 ms
timingIntervention.purpose: Widen the real gap between revisePosition's closed-account precheck and its INSERT

attempts.result: Correction refused because close won before its precheck

attempts.schedule: Correction launched first; close launched 150 ms later
attempts.result: Bug reproduced: both actions redirected as successful and the closed account gained the corrected manual snapshot

caveat: This transcript proves the underlying race is reachable under a widened schedule; it does not estimate how often uninstrumented users hit it.
